race.comment: I'MINTOWIN (2) brings a solid set of figures fourth up and can finally tick off the 1600m box. Sat up on the speed with the 59.5kg from the wide gate to fade late when fourth over 1600m here on October 3. Since fitted with a searching 1250m tick over trial win. No excuses today. DUBAI WARRIOR (9) was unwanted in betting last time (crazy price), with a swooping victory over 1600m at Warwick Farm in BM72 class. In career best form and looks up to this stiffer test. SOSINO (16) third up today and can run a big race after shouldering the 59.5kg for a fighting on speed second over 1600m in the Taree Cup. Goes up a notch but not to be underestimated with the 52kg. FUKUBANA (4) consistent gelding who looks ready for the mile fifth up. Savaged the line as fav when second over 1400m in the LR Tattersall's Members Cup at Eagle Farm. In form jockey engaged and gets map favours. The race doesn't end there.
